ageing_context.regex: \b(?:aging|ageing|age[- ]related|age[- ]dependent|age dependence|older adults?|elderly|adult life ?span|chronological age|vascular age|early vascular aging|early vascular ageing|healthy vascular aging|healthy vascular ageing)\b

arterial_pulse_wave.regex: \b(?:pulse[- ]wave|pulse wave|pulse waveform|pressure waveform|radial pulse|photoplethysm\w*|ppg|pulse transit\w*|augmentation index|reflected wave|wave reflection|arterial waveform|pressure pulse)\b

vascular_age_assessment.regex: \b(?:vascular age|vascular aging|vascular ageing|early vascular aging|early vascular ageing|healthy vascular aging|healthy vascular ageing|predicted age|age estimation|age prediction)\b

reflection_transit.regex: \b(?:wave reflection|reflected wave|reflection sites?|transit time|pulse transit\w*|arrival time|wave transit)\b

simulation_model.regex: \b(?:in silico|in-silico|simulat\w*|virtual patients?|digital twins?|computational model|one-dimensional model|1d model|reduced-order model|lumped[- ]parameter)\b

multimodal_multisite.regex: \b(?:multimodal|multi-modal|multi-site|multisite|multiple signals|multiple sites|pressure and flow|pressure and volume|ppg and|ecg and ppg)\b

measurement_design.regex: \b(?:experimental design|measurement set|measurements needed|sensors?|data acquisition|measurement design|output set|clinical metrics?|clinical measures)\b

collision_classes.C0_direct_collision: Explicitly tests cross-age physiological aliasing/non-uniqueness of arterial pulse phenotypes from known generating cardiovascular states and/or resolves such aliases with added measurements.
collision_classes.C1_strong_conceptual_threat: Direct cardiovascular identifiability, inverse-problem, experimental-design, or arterial-network system-inference precedent that constrains general novelty claims.
collision_classes.C2_strong_domain_neighbor: Direct vascular-age/pulse-wave or age-dependent arterial-dynamics work without the locked global aliasing/rescue conjunction.
collision_classes.C3_close_neighbor: Related arterial-wave, ageing, reflection, transfer, or system-identification work without direct conceptual overlap.
collision_classes.C4_contextual: No material collision with the locked concept.

candidate_audit_rule: all vascular_age_assessment OR (ageing_context AND arterial_pulse_wave) OR all 27 records previously flagged P1/P2 solely to maximize recall; prior labels do not determine final class

negative_control.sampling_frame: records not entering high-relevance collision audit

compact_map_encoding: axis_mask_hex stores bit i for axis_bit_order[i]; primary_role uses CTX/AGE/SYS/WAV/VAGE/INV; high_relevance is 0/1.
